items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: And they come on up with Barney Bigard and —

ctx.x: A couple of years ago someone wrote a nice article about you, a fellow named Aaron Cohen, “Doug Carn’s Big Moment.” And there’s a quote from you in it. It said, “My plan is you better get out of the way because I’m tired of holding back.” And I wonder if at various times in your career did you feel that you were held back from what you really wanted to do?

Yeah. I feel like that right now, because they got it as entertainment only. You know? Because if you look at that, those trees that they have with the roots of jazz you know, down at the bottom they got Satchmo and Bix Beiderbecke, and then they got, you know, the different people you know. And they come on up with Barney Bigard and —
Jelly Roll Morton and those people.
